svg.aria-label: CL65.6 the engine asks its types: who asks them
svg.title: CL65.6 the engine asks its types: who asks them

g.text: CL65.6 the engine asks its types: who asks them
Box, where X, Y, W, H were
to a point, a line, an arc

text.tspan: A layout is handed the geometry and asks a face. What it places holds a box, and a drawing asks that box.
